cr_data.provenance:
[1] 1959, acquired from the artist [1887–1986] (USA) by (The Downtown Gallery, New York, New York, USA); [2] April 1960–August 1961, on loan to Shelburne Museum (Shelburne, Vermont, USA), when returned to (The Downtown Gallery, New York, New York, USA) and later transferred to the personal collection of Edith Gergor Halpert [1900–1970] (New York, New York, USA); [3] March 14–15, 1973, purchased from her estate at auction through (Sotheby Parke-Bernet, New York, New York, USA) by The Bradley Family Foundation (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA); 1977, gift to Milwaukee Art Center (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1], [2] Copy of Bradley catalogue card in MAM object file gives the transfers but without dates. The date of the acquisition by The Downtown Gallery and the date of the return to the gallery is given in Verna Posever Curtis, Georgia O’Keeffe (Milwaukee: Milwaukee Art Center, 1977), p. 12. The date of the loan to Shelburn is given in Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 2 (New Haven: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 756, cat. 1214; Curtis gives this date as 1959. See email in object file from Katie Wood Kirchhoff of the Shelburne Museum clarifying that painting was loaned by Downtown Gallery/Edith Halpert to the Shelburne when donor Electra Havemeyer Webb was interested in expanding the collection there; when she died in November 1960 unexpected, her sun returned the works to the gallery. Transfer to Halpert’s private collection published in Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 2 (New Haven: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 756, cat. 1214. This is also confirmed by Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., Highly Important 19th and 20th century American Paintings, Drawings, Watercolors and Sculpture from the Estate of the Late Edith Gregor Halpert (the Downtown Gallery), March 14–15, 1973 [auction catalogue] (New York: Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., 1973), lot 19. See also Rebecca Shaykin, Edith Halpert: The Downtown Gallery, and the Rise of American Art (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press, 2019), p. 184. 
[3] Invoice addressed to The Bradley Family Foundation in MAM object file, marked paid on March 20, 1973. Confirmed by copy of Bradley catalogue card also in file. See also Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., Highly Important 19th and 20th century American Paintings, Drawings, Watercolors and Sculpture from the Estate of the Late Edith Gregor Halpert (the Downtown Gallery), March 14–15, 1973 [auction catalogue] (New York: Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., 1973), lot 19. See also Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 2 (New Haven: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 756, cat. 1214. See also Curtis, Verna Posever. Georgia O’Keeffe. Milwaukee: Milwaukee Art Center, 1977, pp. 8. 
(Source: MAM, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert— Shelburne, April 1960." (Source: Lynes, 1999)
